review.connection_owner: Hot-path read query and pool return run on existing pool runtime; caller receives owned data; no new pool or batching queue.
review.cancellation: Dropping caller aborts owner JoinSet; existing DiscardOnDrop retires an unfinished physical connection. Independent PostgreSQL observation verifies backend disappearance before replacement check.
review.tenant_and_identity: Same SQL projections, tenant predicates, active flags, secret equality, epoch and private subject binding snapshot. Domain validation executes after connection return.
review.write_boundaries: No changes to transactions, commit acknowledgement, ordered principal/family locks, single-use fence, revocation or Required audit completion.
review.retention_and_export: No changes to safety TTLs, audit append/retry queues, signed checkpoint/ACK, exporter or maintenance scheduling.
review.explicit_limits: Read lifetime regression is deterministic; severe historical capacity loss is not exclusively attributable to it because unchanged A subsequently passed 800 ops/s. Shared infrastructure mechanism is unproven; no host probes.
